The `animal_pose_auditor`'s high ratio of low-confidence keypoints confirms structural ambiguity in the limbs. Additionally, there is slight edge bleeding where the paws meet the wooden post. While the overall fur texture is acceptable, the anatomical failures in the extremities lower the artifact score significantly below the 'clean' reference images.
